description: The driven, damped spring again, studied at 2000 points spread over the driving frequency w and the damping c by a Sobol sequence instead of a grid. Left: where the points fell, coloured by the lag, which turns from 0 to π across the resonance at w ≈ 1, sharply where damping is low. Right: every point's amplitude against w: low damping reaches highest. Try design random or Latin hypercube, or a third parameter, in the study's form (the Inspector).

equations: # steady swing of a driven, damped spring: mass m, stiffness k, damping c, force F at frequency w

spring.description: A driven, damped spring's steady swing: formulas, nothing in time. Its parameters c (damping), m (mass) and w (driving frequency) are set by whatever uses or studies it.
